Ghar Bethan Kamai: Build Your Own Job & Earning Portal

A PKR 20,000 MVP portal with 4 income streams — featured posts, subscriptions, verified passes and referrals — plus the trust features that keep you legal.

A job/earning portal is one of the few software businesses that earns rupees daily after launch. You are the admin — the platform works, the community grows, you collect.

Four income streams

  1. Featured jobs / promoted gigs — employers pay PKR 500–5,000 to top the list
  2. Employer subscriptions — monthly posting packs
  3. Verified-member passes — resume boosts, badge fees
  4. Task & referral engine — sponsors pay per verified signup or completed task

Trust is the product

Pakistan's market is flooded with fake "earning" apps. Your portal survives by shipping KYC verification, employer proof, wallet ledgers with payout queues and fraud guards — all in the MVP we ship for a fixed PKR 20,000 (extended flows quoted on the same rate card).

Timeline

MVP board in ~10 days, full platform in 3 weeks — after you pick your favourite from our 3 free demo designs. Source code and admin panel in Urdu are yours forever.
